description: Registry of models available to the AI Engineering Cockpit platform across providers. Update this file when adding or retiring a model reference used by any project.

models.notes: Default low-cost/fast Gemini chat model used by projects/01-hello-world. Called via the `google-genai` SDK (`from google import genai`); the retired `google-generativeai` package and the gemini-1.5-* model ids it defaulted to now return HTTP 404.
Higher-capability Gemini tier for larger context or more complex reasoning.
DEPRECATED. Google's pricing page lists a shutdown date of 2026-06-01; it still appears in ListModels as of 2026-08-03 but must not be used for new work. Use gemini-2.5-flash.
Rolling alias that tracks the current fast Gemini tier. Convenient for demos; pin an explicit dated/numbered id before production use so behaviour doesn't shift underneath you.
Rolling alias that tracks the current high-capability Gemini tier. Same pinning caveat as gemini-flash-latest.

Gemini embedding model used by projects/02-rag-chatbot retrieval; returns 3072-dimensional vectors. Replaces the retired text-embedding-004. Call via client.models.embed_content(...).embeddings[0].values.

Newer Gemini embedding model, available alongside gemini-embedding-001. Confirm its output dimension against the API before swapping — re-embed your whole corpus when changing embedding models, since vectors from different models are not comparable.
Low-cost OpenAI chat model used for orchestrator comparisons in projects/03-multi-model-orchestrator.
OpenAI embedding model, alternative to Gemini's for RAG retrieval.
Balanced Anthropic Claude tier for general orchestration and long-context tasks. Pin an exact dated model version before production use.
Local model built from models/ollama/Modelfile (llama3 base with project system prompt). Mac hybrid mode only.
Base local model pulled via `ollama pull llama3`. Mac hybrid mode only.
